W: 是啊，他讲课确实不太生动
M: 每次上他的课，我都努力去听
W: 嗯，我的方法就是让笔一直动着
W: 这是我读到的一种主动集中注意力的方法
M: 那你之后会复习你的笔记吗？
W: 有时候会，但这不重要

items.stem: What are scientists planning to do?

choices.text: Land a space vehicle on the moon in 2019.
choices.zh: 在2019年让太空飞行器登陆月球。

choices.text: Design a new generation of mobile phones.
Set up a mobile phone network on the moon.
choices.zh: 在月球上建立移动电话网络。

choices.text: Gather data from the moon with a tiny device.
choices.zh: 用微型设备从月球收集数据。

items.stem: Why did scientists choose to set up a 4G network in their mission?

choices.text: It is stable.
It is durable.
It is inexpensive.
It is sophisticated.

items.stem: What does the news item say about the fire?

choices.text: It lasted more than six hours.
choices.zh: 火灾持续了六个多小时。

choices.text: No injuries were yet reported.
Nobody was in the building when it broke out.
choices.zh: 火灾发生时建筑物内没有人。

choices.text: It had burned for 45 minutes by the time firefighters arrived.
choices.zh: 消防员到达时火灾已经燃烧了45分钟。

items.stem: What had City Hall planned to do?

choices.text: Recruit and train more firefighters.
choices.zh: 招募和培训更多消防员。

choices.text: Pull down the deserted shopping mall.
Turn the shopping mall into an amusement park.
choices.zh: 将购物中心改建成游乐园。

choices.text: Find money to renovate the local neighborhood.
choices.zh: 筹集资金翻新当地社区。

items.stem: What problem is Japan facing?

choices.text: Shrinking potato farming.
Heavy reliance on import.
Widespread plant disease.
Insufficient potato supply.

items.stem: Why does Japan limit the import of potatoes?

choices.text: It intends to keep its traditional diet.
choices.zh: 它打算保持其传统饮食。

choices.text: It wants to expand its own farming.
choices.zh: 它想要扩大自身的农业种植。

choices.text: It is afraid of the spread of disease.
It is worried about unfair competition.

items.stem: What might affect Japanese domestic produce?

choices.text: Global warming.
Ever-rising prices.
Government regulation.
Diminishing investment.

items.stem: What does the man think of Mr. Brown's lectures?

choices.text: Informative.
Inspiring.
Dull.
Shallow.

items.stem: What does the woman do during Mr. Brown's lectures?

choices.text: She types on a keyboard.
She does recording.
She takes photos.
She takes notes.

items.stem: Why does the woman draw in class?

choices.text: It keeps her mind active.
choices.zh: 这让她的思维保持活跃。

choices.text: It makes her stay awake.
It enables her to think hard.
It helps her kill time.

items.stem: What does the woman say about reading out loud?

choices.text: It enables her to improve her pronunciation.
It helps her better remember what she learns.
choices.zh: 它帮助她更好地记住所学内容。

choices.text: It turns out to be an enjoyable way of learning.
choices.zh: 它被证明是一种愉快的学习方式。

choices.text: It proves to be far more effective than writing.
choices.zh: 它被证明比写作有效得多。

items.stem: For what purpose did the woman go to India?

choices.text: To spend her honeymoon.
To try authentic Indian food.
To take photos of the Taj Mahal.
To trace the origin of a love story.
choices.zh: 追溯一个爱情故事的起源。

items.stem: Why was the Taj Mahal built?

choices.text: In memory of a princess.
In honor of a great emperor.
choices.zh: 为向一位伟大的皇帝致敬。

choices.text: To mark the death of an emperor of the 1600s.
choices.zh: 为纪念17世纪一位皇帝的逝世。

choices.text: To celebrate the birth of a princess's 14th child.
choices.zh: 为庆祝一位公主第14个孩子的诞生。

items.stem: What does the woman say about the Taj Mahal?

choices.text: It looks older than expected.
choices.zh: 它看起来比预期的更古老。

choices.text: It is built of wood and bricks.
choices.zh: 它是用木材和砖块建造的。

choices.text: It stores lots of priceless antiques.
choices.zh: 它存放着许多无价的古董。

choices.text: It has walls decorated with jewels.

items.stem: What is the woman's impression of Indian cities?

choices.text: Their streets are narrow.
They are mostly crowded.
Each one has a unique character.
choices.zh: 每座城市都有独特的特色。

choices.text: Life can be tedious in some places.
choices.zh: 有些地方的生活可能很单调。

items.stem: What do most Americans say about local public libraries?

choices.text: They help spread the latest technology.
choices.zh: 它们帮助传播最新技术。

choices.text: They greatly enrich people's leisure life.
choices.zh: 它们极大地丰富了人们的休闲生活。

choices.text: They provide residents with the resources needed.
choices.zh: 它们为居民提供所需的资源。

choices.text: They allow free access to digital books and videos.
choices.zh: 它们允许免费获取数字书籍和视频。

items.stem: How can local public libraries benefit young people?

choices.text: By helping them find jobs.
choices.zh: 通过帮助他们找到工作。

choices.text: By inspiring their creativity.
choices.zh: 通过激发他们的创造力。

choices.text: By keeping them off the streets.
By providing a place of relaxation.
choices.zh: 通过提供一个放松的场所。

items.stem: What does the 2016 survey show about adult library users?

choices.text: Their interaction with teenagers proved fruitful.
choices.zh: 他们与青少年的互动被证明是有成效的。

choices.text: They used libraries less often than teenagers.
choices.zh: 他们使用图书馆的频率低于青少年。

choices.text: They tended to visit libraries regularly.
choices.zh: 他们倾向于定期访问图书馆。

choices.text: Their number increased modestly.

items.stem: What do we learn about the Savannah cat?

choices.text: It is the cleverest cat in the world.
choices.zh: 它是世界上最聪明的猫。

choices.text: It is the largest cat in Africa.
It is an unusual cross breed.
choices.zh: 它是一种不寻常的杂交品种。

choices.text: It is a large-sized wild cat.

items.stem: What is characteristic of Savannah cats?

choices.text: They are as loyal as dogs.
They have unusually long tails.
They are fond of sleeping in cabinets.
They know how to please their owners.
choices.zh: 它们知道如何取悦主人。

items.stem: What do some people do with their Savannah cats?

choices.text: They shake their front paws.
They teach them to dive.
They shower with them.
They shout at them.

items.stem: How do parents feel when their children start going to school?

choices.text: Anxious and depressed.
Contented and relieved.
Excited but somewhat sad.
Proud but a bit nervous.

items.stem: What does the passage say about children's education?

choices.text: It is becoming parents' biggest concern.
choices.zh: 它正在成为家长最大的担忧。

choices.text: It is gaining increasing public attention.
choices.zh: 它正在获得越来越多的公众关注。

choices.text: It depends on their parents for success.
choices.zh: 它的成功取决于孩子的父母。

choices.text: It starts the moment they are born.
choices.zh: 它从孩子出生的那一刻就开始了。

items.stem: What should parents do for the success of their children's education?

choices.text: Set a good example for them to follow.
choices.zh: 为他们树立一个好榜样供其效仿。

choices.text: Read books and magazines to them.
Help them to learn by themselves.
Choose the right school for them.
choices.zh: 为他们选择合适的学校。

items.stem: What does the passage say is the key factor of children's academic success?

choices.text: Their intelligence.
Their home life.
The effort they put in learning.
choices.zh: 他们在学习上投入的努力。

choices.text: The quality of their school.
